reviews.text:
Eli did a great job serving us at the Leaside location.

Food was great and service was fast and professional
Karina was amazing and provided such a warm and inviting experience for us. Everything was quick and the food and drinks were great. Definitely will come back!!
Had a great experience tonight! Will was an excellent server, friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was taken care of. Really appreciated the great service. Thanks, Will!
Derks is amazing. Did I say amazing, this girl wears a cape. Beer always fresh any questioned answered. Great service employee of the month already.

We had an amazing experience at Local Public Eatery on Laird in Leaside, and a huge part of that was our server, Christina! She was incredibly friendly, attentive, and welcoming throughout our entire visit. She made sure everything was perfect, checked in on us at the right times, and made the whole experience so enjoyable. Her positive attitude and excellent service really stood out and made our visit even better. It’s not every day you come across a server who genuinely makes you feel so welcome. Christina is a great example of what outstanding customer service should look like!

Thank you, Christina, for making our experience so great. We’ll definitely be back! Highly recommend asking for Christina if you visit this location! 👏
Christina was electric and so was Will at the front door
Will Kiely and Christina were so good at their jobs!
Christina was my server tonight and she always made sure our glasses were full. Shoutout to will as well for greeting us at the front door. Will definitely be coming back.
Local is a fantastic restaurant. Always love the food and service. Highly recommend going. Had Kaitlyn as my waitress. Very fun and nice person great service.

Our server, Aisia, was fantastic. Very attentive and extremely friendly. We were promplty seated at the empty booth we requested, our drinks were always full, and my friend, who wanted the sold out fish tacos, was accommodated with an off-menu chicken taco by recommendation of our server.

The food was mid. I found my fish greasy and the batter wasn't great, but that's a kitchen issue.

The atmosphere was typical of a pub. The "highlight" was when another server's hair caught fire on an open candle flame. It definitely stunk for a while, which isn't ideal over dinner.

This is a place that has excellent service and a typical pub atmosphere. I wouldn't order the fish again, but I'm sure there's something on the menu worth trying.
Christina was a phenomenal waitress and she accommodated our large rugby team amazing. She was honestly one of the best waitresses I’ve ever had in my life 5 star service.
Food was amazing and came very fast. Our waiter Christina was the best.
The food was very good and Christina was a very good waitress.
Christina offered amazing service and was kind regardless of our large group.
Christina was the best give her employee of the century
Great service from Christina. Will definitely be back!

McKenzie and Katherine were both very welcoming! I was able to sit in a very nice seating area with window view and under nice lighting! Katherine had been very helpful in what options were available for me, which I greatly appreciated! :) I order BBQ rice bowl with tofu, and it was amazing! The salad had a nice tangy touch. The rice, aioli, with egg added a nice umami flavour, and the tofu was sweet and crispy with a soft and a slightly chewy texture!
Overall, all the different textures and flavours lead me to have an amazing and fulfilling experience :D

Staff are always so friendly!
Never been disappointed with the food

I am brand new to the area and decided to try this spot out I am so glad I did! The food was delicious, but what really made the night was our server, Derka. She was incredibly warm, welcoming, and attentive. She completely elevated the entire dining experience. I will definitely be back, honestly just to see her again! Highly recommend!
Had such an amazing time dining at Locals! Our server, Derka, truly made our night memorable with her exceptional service! We’ll definitely be coming back and hope to have her as our server again!
Great service & food

Great place to get some food, watch sports and have a good time with friends and family. Atmosphere is excellent. Lots of different options for food and drinks! Derks is a excellent server as well, attentive and friendly.

Beautiful establishment with a lively atmosphere, timely and attentive service, and tasty drinks!

And proper thanks to our waitress, Derks, she was amazing when me and my friend’s visited! Friendly, attentive, and a wonderful waitress. Would highly recommend this establishment to anyone considering visiting a bar or eatery within the Leaside general area.
Derka was the best server ever! She was very a tentative and helped us with picking things to have when we had trouble on picking what to get. The pour on was the best part of the night! 10/10!
Derka was an amazing server! She made sure we had everything and always checked in on us! Had a great time here. Would recommend this place to anyone looking for good food and drinks :)
Matteo and Derka were awesome!  food was outstanding as always.  Amazing service as well!   Loved it and great experience!
Matteo and Dharka  were  amazing.   Really took care of of us.    was super friendly  and very good service.
Dharka was really good and friendly   Very good service
Amazing customer service from our server Eli! My girls enjoyed their birthday AND their first time at Local Leaside. We loved the food!
Danielle was a fantastic server!
Always a 'local' favourite with the family. Maria and Will are awesome servers. Super friendly and great service. Thank you.

We have had lunch numerous times at the LOCAL.  We meet up with a friend who has a dog, and their patio is dog-friendly.   The patio is lovely and despite being adjacent to a busy street (Laird) it feels quiet and secluded.  Nice big umbrellas and trees to provide lots of shade.  Great menu of delicious items.

I came to eat earlier today with my friend and still thinking about the positive experience I had so thought I’d share. I am totally astounded by the service Tomi provided for me and my friends! From the beginning it felt like we’d been friends for ages! She recommended dishes for all of us and made my friend who is celiac and usually anxious at restaurants feel extremely comfortable and relaxed. I can say wholeheartedly I have never had service quite like this. Thank you Tomi and can’t wait to go to Local Leaside again soon!

The atmosphere was great, but the service was really disappointing. We had to wait about 20 minutes just to place our order, and then the server came back 15 minutes later only to realize they had completely forgotten it. We went on a weekday, and they were definitely understaffed.
Update: The service was better on this visit, and changed the review from 2 to 3 star.
Tomi was amazing
Amazing service feom Tom for lunch!!
Toni was so wonderful! Great service and was super accommodating of our dietary restrictions.
Great service Tomi
Tomi was great!
Tomi was kind, attentive and provided excellent customer service. We'll be back!
We were served by Derks.  She was awesome.  Gave such great service.  She was pleasant and engaged so well with our grandson.  We loved the experience.

The restaurant still has a great atmosphere and excellent staff, which keeps the experience enjoyable. However, the food quality has noticeably decreased compared to a few years ago, especially the burgers that once made this place stand out.
Paulveen was our server last night for our first time at the restaurant! She was super sweet and provided exceptional service!
Server was very good. Attentive but not hovering. Beer/food was amazing. We had a great time!

First bad experience at the Local after many good ones.  Seated upstairs  and jammed together on what appears to be patio furniture.  There's no space to get by.  Really loud making conversation difficult.   Service was poor though likely more due to staffing as opposed to lack of effort of the staff that was there.  Food was good though served lukewarm...due to noted staffing issues?  All in all less than "good" experience.

They weren’t kidding when suggesting the banana cream pie was a must order! Delicious.

Was wowed less by the cesar salad. Probably just a taste palette preference. Loved the crouton texture though.

Companions enjoyed their salmon and burger.

Service was excellent. Was nice to see that it was a shared effort across all team members. A bit concerned at first about the number of high top tables but fortunately we were seated at a circular booth.

Looking forward to returning to try some other menu items. And maybe even participate in trivia night!
Enjoyed the visit the other night! Huge shoutout to Christina for taking care of us! 🇲🇰🤝🏻🇬🇷
I ate here with my friend and everything was amazing. Christina provided really good service and was very friendly and welcoming . Will definitely be coming back!
Christina was great! Very friendly, provided great recommendations (try the wings they were 10/10) and constantly checked up on us to make sure we were having a great experience!!
Maria was a great server. Very kind and very helpful.
Maria was an amazing hostess
Micheal and Maria were amazing. Exceeded expectations.
Michael and Maria were great fantastic service 10/10
We had a really great time. Service was great. Food was great as well. Will be back for sure!
Matthew did a great job serving my friend Dave and I over lunch.
Good foods, great time in a lovely neighborhood.
Meklit and Will were great servers. Amazing and friendly service, drinks came out quick and they were super kind!!
Will, Karina, Michael and Meklit were an absolute delight
Welcomed by our waiter Will. Super hospitable, great service. For sure coming back again!!!
Will was unreal. Floating around the table a perfect amount don’t think I went without a beer in my hand. Great dude
Dirka was fantastic. Great service, very friendly and knowledgeable about the menu.
Lovely service! Meklit was so kind and was a pleasure.

WOW!!!! Had the absolute BEST experience here tonight. Between the dining and service, it was the ultimate fun and friendly combo. Shoutout Matteo (a stellar server), Aisia, Meklit, Maria, Nicky, Hasmik, Aimee, Annabel, and Mia (for her awesome trivia) as well as Vicco!!! Will definitely be coming back. - also, highly recommend the new menu Korean BBQ Pork Lettuce wraps, a new staple for this group of girls. - Sofie, Jules, Veronika
Tomi was super nice and had great service. Very nice experience overall.
Great restaurant & Tomi  a fantastic waitress;-)
Tomi was an excellent waitress. Always a blast coming here.
Tomi was the best!
Maria was amazing. One of the best servers that I ever have had
Maria was an excellent host!
Danielle was so amazing, and lovely. Had the best service, she rocked!
Danielle killed it.  Best server ever
We had a fantastic time thank to Danielle and staff. She was friendly, amazing, attentive and funny

The atmosphere is lively, the drinks are cold, the food is delicious, and the staff are incredible. Maria is incredibly friendly, personable, and very professional. Her demeanor, and kindness makes you feel like more or a long time friend than a patron. A long with Nikola the manager, they are a dream team. Smiles, banter and sincere care makes you feel like you're at dinner party with close friends more than your local pub.

Akiko was great.  Very attentive.
Thanks for making a great night!

Amazing spot!
Perfectly taken care of by Derks!
we have a great time  in local public eatery. The service of Derks was amazing she was very attentive fun and perfect . She gave good recommendations and make all of us have a good time.
Great spot to hit up for a drink and great service. Derks was lit and Jackie is da bomb
The food is great, and Carolina was very fast with our service.
Carolina was excellent - she provided great service and was extremely welcoming.
Great service! Kalypsa was wonderful! Very attentive and gave great suggestions about menu items and drinks!
Great night out
It was a great place to eat! And our server Kalypsa was amazing!
Awesome spot for a large gathering upstairs on the indoor patio. Kalypsa was an awesome waitress for our retirement party. Incredible service.
Kalypsa was so amazing! Such a fun vibe and very attentive. Would come back just for this amazing service!
Local is always a lovely place to visit with great food and Christina was a great server. Will definitely come back!

Our Local spot. The vibe is lively. The food is consistently delicious. Our server, Mia, was outstanding, friendly and a stellar host.

Whether Hubby and I are without kids around or taking the whole family with us, Local will always be our go-to.
Great customer service by Maria!
Great customer service from Maria.
Maria was a great server, incredibly personable, fast service. Also great insight on engagement rings.
Maria was amazing. Excellent customer service and very professional.  Definitely coming back.
Very welcoming and took good care of us.
Qam was an amazing server. Very friendly and gifted us a free dessert for our first visit. I’d highly recommend local as a spot to eat and hangout. The food was great as well. Thanks Qam!

Everything was great, food was good, service was great, especially “Kalypsa & Maria”, they took well care of us throughout the night keeping the drinks flowing and overall just being so nice and accommodating
